sloka: तां तु दृष्ट्वा च धऋत्या च दाक्षिण्येन निपात्य च ।स कपिप्रवरो वेगाद्ववृधे पुनरात्मवान् ॥५-१-१९५॥
transliteration: tāṁ tu dṛṣṭvā ca dhaṛtyā ca dākṣiṇyena nipātya ca ।sa kapipravaro vegādvavṛdhe punarātmavān ॥5-1-195॥

translations.english: Selfcontrolled Hanuman, the great monkey acting with firmness of mind and ingenuity threw her down and once again rapidly grew in size.
